## Wire numbering result

I numbered the **13 nets** of the starter circuit. Here is what changed:

- Every net now has *one* number
- Wires of one net share it
- `L1`, `L2` and `L3` start at 101

1. Check the numbers on page 1
2. Run **Check > Design checks**
3. Save the project

| Net | Wire number | Page |
|---|---|---|
| L1 | 101 | 1 |
| L2 | 102 | 1 |
| PE | 900 | 2 |

```
kopercad-cli number starter.kopercad --scheme plain
```

Nothing else was changed.
